title: Bug: bmcctld fails to start due to missing /host/bmc/ directory
author: Yakiv-Huryk
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

The bmcctld in PMON fails on attempt to create a logger:

```
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld   File "/usr/local/bin/bmcctld", line 272, in <module>
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld     _event_logger = EventLogger(SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER, CRITICAL_EVENT_LOG_FILE)
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld   File "/usr/local/bin/bmcctld", line 90, in __init__
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld     handler = logging.FileHandler(log_file)
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld   File "/usr/lib/python3.11/logging/__init__.py", line 1181, in __init__
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld     StreamHandler.__init__(self, self._open())
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld                                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld   File "/usr/lib/python3.11/logging/__init__.py", line 1213, in _open
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld     return open_func(self.baseFilename, self.mode,
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
INFO pmon#supervisord: bmcctld FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/host/bmc/event.log'
```

The reason is that the /host/bmc/ is not created on the first boot (`firsttime_exit` is called before creating the /host/bmc/)
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/00d16d5400f2f4f8e9d236eb0623b6dfcfcc46ff/files/image_config/platform/rc.local#L431-L445

Then the pmon container is created w/o the `/host/bmc` mapping:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/00d16d5400f2f4f8e9d236eb0623b6dfcfcc46ff/files/build_templates/docker_image_ctl.j2#L792


### Steps to Reproduce

Deploy the BMC image and grep bmcctld logs.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The `/host/bmc` should be created at the first boot.

comments.author: prajjwal-arista
comments.body:
@judyjoseph I validated the fix and it is **not working**.
The issue is that the pmon service is not run as root user, and hence these commands fail permissions
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/be9722abb26eac7fda806a31ed80ba1bc4694689/files/build_templates/pmon.service.j2#L11


Failiure logs:
```
admin@sonic:~$   sudo journalctl -u pmon | grep -i -E 'platform|bmc|host/bmc' | head -20
Jun 19 06:58:10 sonic systemd[1]: Starting pmon.service - Platform monitor container...
Jun 19 06:58:12 sonic pmon.sh[2658]: mkdir: cannot create directory ‘/host/bmc’: Permission denied
Jun 19 06:58:12 sonic pmon.sh[2667]: touch: cannot touch '/host/bmc/event.log': No such file or directory
Jun 19 06:58:12 sonic pmon.sh[2669]: chmod: cannot access '/host/bmc/event.log': No such file or directory
Jun 19 06:58:37 sonic systemd[1]: Started pmon.service - Platform monitor container.
```
